commitResults.messageTitle: Merge branch 'branch-Level-7' add storage class to save files
Extract terminal interactions into Ui class
commitResults.messageBody: Move command input, banner display, and formatted message output behind a dedicated Ui abstraction. Convert the existing message helper to generate response text only, so BruCLI coordinates behavior without directly using Scanner or System.out. This creates the first standalone component toward the target OOP design while preserving existing command and persistence behavior.

commitResults.messageTitle: Extract task persistence into Storage class
commitResults.messageBody: Move file-path ownership, task serialization, and saved-task reconstruction out of BruCLI into a constructor-configured Storage component. Propagate I/O and malformed-data failures to BruCLI so the application layer decides how to notify the user. Centralize save error handling in saveTasks while preserving the existing text format and command behavior.

commitResults.messageTitle: Extract task collection behavior into TaskList
commitResults.messageBody: Introduce TaskList as the owner of task creation, ID assignment, lookup validation, completion changes, deletion, reindexing, and date-filtered selection. Replace BruCLI's direct ArrayList manipulation with intention-revealing TaskList operations, and expose an immutable snapshot for persistence. This narrows BruCLI to command coordination while preserving user-facing task numbers and existing storage behavior.

commitResults.messageTitle: Extract command interpretation into Parser class
commitResults.messageBody: Move command recognition, argument extraction, task-number conversion, date parsing, and LIST filter parsing from BruCLI into a dedicated Parser component. Give BruCLI a Parser instance and keep its run loop focused on dispatching already-interpreted commands. Preserve the existing syntax, strict date validation, zero-based task ID conversion, and user-facing error messages.

Replace static application state with final TaskList, Ui, Storage, and Parser instance fields initialized by a file-path constructor. Load persisted tasks during construction, retain graceful malformed-file fallback, and make run an instance method invoked by new BruCLI("tasks.txt"). This establishes explicit object ownership needed for command objects without changing command behavior.

commitResults.messageTitle: Introduce command hierarchy for exit control flow
commitResults.messageBody: Rename the parsing enum to CommandType to distinguish command classification from executable Command objects. Add an abstract Command contract with execute and isExit behavior, then extract ExitCommand and UnknownCommand from BruCLI's switch. Route exit-loop control through Command.isExit and prepare checked storage failures for later state-changing command classes while preserving all existing responses.

commitResults.messageTitle: Extract non-mutating list and sudo commands
commitResults.messageBody: Move task-list rendering and sudo handling out of BruCLI into ListCommand and SudoCommand. Store the optional date filter as immutable ListCommand state, demonstrating how parsed arguments belong to executable command objects. Preserve original task numbering, empty-result messaging, inclusive and exclusive filtering semantics, and existing terminal responses.

Move mark, unmark, and delete execution from BruCLI into dedicated Command subclasses that carry immutable task IDs. Introduce TaskMutationCommand to centralize the target ID and persistence of immutable TaskList snapshots. Save before displaying success so storage failures propagate through the command loop without producing a misleading confirmation, while preserving validation and deletion reindexing.

Move todo, deadline, and event creation from BruCLI into dedicated executable commands carrying their parsed descriptions and date-time values. Introduce AddCommand for shared description state and snapshot persistence. Save each new task before displaying success, preserve strict date validation and ISO storage, and remove BruCLI's remaining direct task-creation and save-helper logic.

commitResults.messageTitle: Return executable commands directly from Parser
commitResults.messageBody: Replace the intermediate CommandType and ParsedCommand model with direct construction of Command subclasses in Parser. Reduce BruCLI's run loop to read, parse, execute, and inspect isExit, eliminating its dispatch switch entirely. Preserve validation messages, parsed LocalDateTime state, unknown and sudo behavior, and the previously silent GAME command through NoOpCommand.

commitResults.messageTitle: Decouple commands from BruCLI presentation details
commitResults.messageBody: Move randomized response generation from the nested BruCLI.Messages helper into a standalone package-private Messages class used only by Ui. Add intention-revealing Ui methods for command outcomes and errors, then update every command to request presentation behavior without accessing message text or BruCLI internals. Extract ListFilter as a standalone value type so ListCommand also loses its main-class dependency, while preserving responses, filtering semantics, persistence, and malformed-file handling.

commitResults.messageTitle: Extract task domain model from BruCLI
commitResults.messageBody: Move date conversion and the Task hierarchy into standalone DateTimes, Task, Todo, Deadline, and Event classes. Update Parser, Storage, and TaskList to depend directly on domain types instead of nested BruCLI members. Preserve LocalDateTime filtering, human-readable display, ISO persistence, reconstruction, completion state, and deletion reindexing while reducing BruCLI to application composition and command-loop coordination.

commitResults.messageTitle: Organize source classes into Java packages
commitResults.messageBody: Introduce brucli as the root package and group executable commands, parsing, storage, task-domain classes, and UI concerns into focused subpackages beneath src/main/java. Update imports and cross-package visibility, including public task serialization for Storage, preserve Messages as a package-private UI helper, and update the IntelliJ launch path documented in README. Keep all runtime behavior and persistence formats unchanged.
